def verify_seq05_reconnect_recovery(
    elapsed_recover_ms: int,
    recovered_snapshot: Dict[str, object],
) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    校验 SEQ-05 重连恢复契约（`HIL-CASE-46`）：
    要求 `0 <= elapsed_recover_ms <= 3000`，`mc_online=True`、`th_online=True`、状态为 `READY`/`IDLE`，
    `telemetry_quality == "FRESH"`，且喷头 (`5000..300000 m°C`) 与热床 (`5000..130000 m°C`) 退出离线/故障哨兵并恢复 `FRESH`。
    """
    if elapsed_recover_ms < 0 or elapsed_recover_ms > AISOC_FRESHNESS_FAULT_MS:
        return False, f"elapsed_recover_ms {elapsed_recover_ms}ms out of [0, 3000]ms"
    if recovered_snapshot.get("mc_online") is not True or recovered_snapshot.get("th_online") is not True:
        return False, "mc_online/th_online not restored to True"
    state_val = recovered_snapshot.get("system_status") or recovered_snapshot.get("device_state")
    if state_val not in ("READY", "IDLE"):
        return False, f"unexpected recovered state: {state_val}"
    if recovered_snapshot.get("telemetry_quality") != "FRESH":
        return False, "recovered telemetry_quality is not FRESH"
    bed = recovered_snapshot.get("bed")
    tool = recovered_snapshot.get("tool")
    if not isinstance(bed, dict) or not isinstance(tool, dict):
        return False, "missing bed or tool telemetry in recovered snapshot"
    bed_t = int(bed.get("temperature_millic", AISOC_TEMP_MILLIC_OFFLINE))
    tool_t = int(tool.get("temperature_millic", AISOC_TEMP_MILLIC_OFFLINE))
    sentinels = (AISOC_TEMP_MILLIC_OFFLINE, AISOC_TEMP_MILLIC_FAULT)
    if bed_t in sentinels or not (AISOC_BED_VALID_MIN_MILLIC <= bed_t <= AISOC_BED_VALID_MAX_MILLIC):
        return False, f"recovered bed temperature_millic {bed_t} invalid or sentinel"
    if tool_t in sentinels or not (AISOC_NOZZLE_VALID_MIN_MILLIC <= tool_t <= AISOC_NOZZLE_VALID_MAX_MILLIC):
        return False, f"recovered tool temperature_millic {tool_t} invalid or sentinel"
    if bed.get("quality") != "FRESH" or tool.get("quality") != "FRESH":
        return False, "recovered bed/tool quality must be FRESH"
    return True, "SEQ-05 reconnect recovery verified"
